text: At its meeting of April 11, 2019, the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee elected Stefanie Marinich-Lee and Glen Hart as the two Vice Chairs of the Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until successors are appointed. There is currently a vacancy in one of the positions of Vice Chair due to the resignation of Stefanie Marinich Lee. The Committee may elect a member as Vice Chair for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed. All members are eligible for election.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Liv Mendelsohn as Vice Chair of the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until successors are appointed.
